hooks.command: b=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null); if [ "$b" != "main" ]; then exit 0; fi; if [ -e .git/MERGE_HEAD ] || [ -d .git/rebase-merge ] || [ -d .git/rebase-apply ]; then exit 0; fi; if [ -n "$(git status --porcelain)" ]; then git add -A && git commit -m "auto-sync $(date +%Y-%m-%d_%H:%M:%S)" >/dev/null 2>&1; fi; git push origin main >/dev/null 2>&1; exit 0
